verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching bulk work is file-based 1099 submission: the Taxpayer Portal accepts 1099 XML files that follow the IRS IRIS schema, which implies batch submission of information returns. Nothing documents general bulk actions across many filings, accounts or licenses. Amendments are explicitly limited to one tax period at a time, and probes found no API or OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that one file can carry many records, bulk operations beyond W2/1099 submission (batch filing, payment or license renewal), programmatic or API-driven bulk access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Only the 1099 XML file format will be accepted via the DE Taxpayer Portal.
Division of Revenue will follow the same schema formats as the IRS, available on the IRS IRIS website.
